'''Otarin''' is one of the [[Heroes of the Horn]]. 

== Summoned by the Horn ==
He appears at [[Falme]] when [[Matrim Cauthon]] blows the [[Horn of Valere]]. [[Rand al'Thor]] knows him as Oscar as well as Otarin.{{ref/book|2|47}}

== Parallels ==
Otarin as Oscar is based on a [[wikipedia:Oscar (Irish mythology)|popular character]] in the Fenian Cycle of Irish mythology.{{ref|[[Origins of the Wheel of Time]], Otarin}} He "was the fiercest fighter in battle among all the Fians. He slew in his maiden battle three kings, and in his fury he also slew by mischance his own friend and condisciple Linne."<ref>[https://www.gutenberg.org/files/14749/14749-h/14749-h.htm The High Deeds of Finn and other Bardic Romances of Ancient Ireland, by T. W. Rolleston]</ref>
